first_business_attempt.reason: Incorrect expectation that native SDK redispatches an already-resolved call ID and appends a second result
first_business_attempt.classification: Test expectation mismatch against pinned SDK completed-call handling; no production defect confirmed.

test_correction.original_wrong_assumption: A model request repeating a completed call ID would redispatch the governed tool, consume a third root tool call and append a second ToolResult.
test_correction.confirmed_sdk_behavior: The fixed SDK filters completed tool IDs before acting. No second governed dispatch occurs; the parent consumes the saved result and root tool count remains two.
test_correction.changed_expectations: Assert one wire result against the paused canonical child receipt, root model 5 / tool 2 / child 1, while preserving the explicit repeated CALL/input and all A/B, budget, privacy, attempt and binding checks.
test_correction.unchanged_test_limits: No timeout, budget, profile, child-count or authorization/privacy assertion was weakened.

sdk_primary_evidence.execution: CallExecution.getPendingToolUseIds collects context ToolResult IDs; lambda$getPendingToolUseIds$8 excludes a requested ID already in that result set. An empty acting list continues executeIteration without dispatch.
sdk_primary_evidence.formatter: OpenAIChatFormatter.doFormat adds each formatted message; no formatter deduplication explains the observed single result.

execution_contract.path: Native parent delegate -> committed child business result -> real request_city waiting/sealed receipt -> same-JVM Spring restart -> HTTP answer/new attempt -> repeated same-call request skipped by SDK -> parent consumes saved result
execution_contract.state_preserved_across_restart: PostgreSQL and the loopback SSE server/captured requests remain alive; only the Spring application context restarts.
execution_contract.result_reuse: The resumed root checkpoint preserves the completed tool result, checked against the paused committed child receipt. This case neither re-enters the business child-result cache branch nor resumes or adopts old child SDK final checkpoints.
execution_contract.memory: The original Turn retains profile A; a later ordinary Turn reads profile B.
execution_contract.release: The old frozen binding and completed result remain unchanged when leaf current becomes non-empty; this case does not re-enter beginPrivate to resolve the target again.
execution_contract.answer_replay: Replaying the same HTTP answer must not produce a third attempt or another model request.
execution_contract.budget: A root model limit of three must not reset when the answered interaction creates a new attempt.
execution_contract.repeated_call: The model explicitly requests the same call ID/input, but the SDK filters completed IDs before acting; no second governed tool dispatch occurs, so root tool count remains two.
execution_contract.saved_result_reference: The sole wire result was checked against the independently captured canonical committed child receipt from the paused state.

positive_with_next_turn_wire_calls.note: Includes one parent request in the later ordinary Turn; first-Turn persistent counters remain separate.
